hooks.command: (diff -q "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/package.json" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/package.json" >/dev/null 2>&1 && diff -q "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/package-lock.json" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/package-lock.json" >/dev/null 2>&1) || (mkdir -p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}" && cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}" && cp "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/package.json" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/package-lock.json" . && npm install --prefer-offline --no-audit --omit=dev) || { rm -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/package.json" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/package-lock.json"; exit 1; }
